name: o78460

_def.title: Default language override
_def.description: Optional key of the default language for this link

additionalProperties.title: URI for language <key>
additionalProperties.description: The key is ISO 639-1 Language Code

description:
Dear Team,

Please note that the main entry point for the new resource is https://example.com/resource. For users who prefer English the default language, we will direct them to https://example.com/en/resource, and the system is configured to treat English (code “en”) as the fallback language whenever a locale‑specific version is unavailable.

We have also prepared dedicated pages for other supported languages: the German version is available at https://example.com/de/resource, the Spanish at https://example.com/es/resource, the Finnish at https://example.com/fi/resource, the French at https://example.com/fr/resource, and the Italian at https://example.com/it/resource. These links should be used in the localized interfaces accordingly.
